options.text: The study lounge will immediately get more seats.
The university will not add more seats until the safety inspection is done.
The fire-safety inspection was completed last term.
Students have already moved to a different lounge.

back_content.text: 答案：B。but 后的 not add more seats until... 才是本句真正结论。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The university promised to redesign the study lounge, but it has decided not to add more seats until the fire-safety inspection is completed next term.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：but 把前半句的积极承诺 redesign the study lounge 转向后半句的限制结论 not add more seats。② 核心规律：CET6 转折题里，前半句常是让步或背景，but / however 后才是可作答的信息重心。③ 验证与迁移：如果你只记住 redesign，就会选到前置铺垫；正确流程是先定位转折词，再把答案锚定在转折后的动作和限制条件。
tips: 听到 but 后，先问：前面哪一点被削弱或限制了？
转折后若出现 not / until 这类限制词，通常就是答案区。

options.text: The owner has already moved the shop to campus.
The station area has become too expensive for the shop.
The shop will remain near the station for practical reasons.
Morning commuters no longer visit the shop.

back_content.text: 答案：C。However 后说明租金更低、通勤客方便，所以店会留在车站附近。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The owner considered moving the coffee shop closer to the university. However, the rent near the station is lower, so the business will stay where morning commuters can easily reach it.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：considered moving 只是前置想法，However 后的 stay 才是最终行动。② 核心规律：转折结构经常把“想过的方案”放在前面，再用 however 改写最终结论；作答时要优先抓后半句的动作词。③ 验证与迁移：A 把旧想法当成结果，B 反转了租金信息，D 夸大了通勤客变化；只有 C 同时覆盖 stay 和 practical reasons。
tips: considered / planned / hoped 这类词不等于最终决定。
听到 however 后，立刻寻找决定性动作：stay、cancel、delay、require 等。

options.text: They can complete all first-year courses online.
They must complete chemistry lab sessions on campus every week.
Commuters are exempt from laboratory requirements.
The department will remove weekly lab sessions.

back_content.text: 答案：B。前半句承认线上课灵活，but 后真正强调实验课仍需每周线下完成。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Online classes are certainly more flexible for commuters, but the chemistry department still requires first-year students to complete their lab sessions on campus every week.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：certainly more flexible 是让步铺垫，but 后的 still requires 才是硬性要求。② 核心规律：CET6 转折句常用“承认一个好处 + 保留一个限制”的结构，答案通常落在限制对行动的影响上。③ 验证与迁移：A 和 C 都把灵活性误读成豁免，D 则反向理解 requires；B 才保留了 but 后的要求、对象和频率。
tips: 转折后出现 requires / must / still，优先当作高权重信息。
复述长句时可先压缩成“虽然灵活，但是仍必须……”的答题框架。

still wait 这种保留问题的表达常是说话者真正想强调的点。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断 nevertheless 引导的逻辑转折关系。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The project seemed to be on track; nevertheless, a series of unforeseen technical failures brought it to a complete standstill by the third quarter.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：nevertheless = 尽管如此，强转折词，前提与结果相反。② 核心规律：CET6 转折题：nevertheless/nonetheless/even so = 强转折，后文是真实局面，前文是表面铺垫。③ 验证与迁移：正确答案应反映转折后的负面结果，而非前文的表面顺利。
tips: nevertheless/nonetheless 后内容 = 真实情况，前面的正向描述是背景对比。
"seemed to be on track" = 表面假象，答案在 nevertheless 之后。

back_content.text: 结论：最终评价为负面：however 引出方法论缺陷，使结果有效性受损。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Initially, the clinical trials produced highly encouraging results. However, a closer examination of the methodology revealed significant flaws that undermined the validity of the findings.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：however 是标准转折词，后接 flaws = 负面评价，推翻之前 encouraging 的正面评价。② 核心规律：CET6 学术型转折题：initial finding + however + contradiction = 经典转折结构，答案在 however 之后。③ 验证与迁移："closer examination" = 深入研究，是换更批判视角后发现问题的固定说法。
tips: "initially...however" = CET6 科研类听力的高频结构，后半句是最终结论。
undermined the validity = 破坏了有效性，答案方向：results are NOT reliable。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断环保团体的游说与政策结果之间的逻辑关系。

back_content.text: 结论：尽管多年游说（let步），政策仍未解决核心问题（真实结果）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Despite years of lobbying by environmental groups, the government's new policy framework still does not address the core issue of carbon emissions from heavy industry.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：Despite = 让步/转折介词，前接被否定的努力，后是未达成的实际情况。② 核心规律：Despite/In spite of + 名词短语 = 转折，说明努力或条件未能改变最终结果。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：the policy fails to address carbon emissions from industry（努力失效）。
tips: Despite/In spite of + 名词 = 转折，后主句是结论，前介短语是被否定的努力。
"still does not" = 仍然没有，强调转折后的持续负面状态。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The new software promised unprecedented efficiency gains; yet in practice, most users reported that the system was far too complex to navigate without expert assistance.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：yet（转折词）+ "in practice" = 现实与理想的对比，typically marks practical failure after theoretical promise。② 核心规律：CET6 理想vs现实转折：promised/claimed/expected + yet/but/in reality = 实际效果不如预期。③ 验证与迁移：answer = software is too complex to use without expert help（现实面），非 unprecedented efficiency（理想面）。
tips: in practice / in reality / in fact = 后接真实情况，前面是理论或预期。
promised + yet = 广告/宣称的功能被否定，选项含 "difficult" 或 "inadequate" 方向。

back_content.text: 结论：股东正面反应 vs 分析师警告（长期策略缺乏财务基础）= Nonetheless 引导的转折对比。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The CEO's speech was received positively by shareholders. Nonetheless, analysts warned that the company's long-term strategy lacked the financial fundamentals to sustain growth.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：Nonetheless = nevertheless 的同义词，后接分析师更专业的批评视角。② 核心规律：CET6 多方意见差异题：A said X + nonetheless + B warned Y = 两种评价的转折并存。③ 验证与迁移：answering questions about analysts' view = look after nonetheless；questions about shareholders' view = before nonetheless。
tips: 多主语转折题：确认每句话的 subject 是谁，防止混淆不同人的立场。
分析师/专家的转折评论往往是考题重点，比普通人立场更权威。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断对此次并购的最终综合评价。

back_content.text: 结论：表面上看是战略佳作，但综合整合成本与文化冲突后，实际表现远不理想。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：On the surface, the merger appeared to be a strategic masterstroke. But when the integration costs and cultural clashes were factored in, it became clear that the deal was far from ideal.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："On the surface" = 表面层面（前景虚假），"but when...factored in" = 深层分析（真实情况）。② 核心规律：on the surface / at first glance / apparently = 表面描述，其后必有 but/yet/however 触发真实评价。③ 验证与迁移：答案聚焦真实局面：far from ideal，而非表面层面的 masterstroke。
tips: "on the surface" = 前面是表象，准备等 but，真相在后。
"far from ideal" = 委婉的强烈否定，等于 quite bad，CET6 常用这类婉转否定表达。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断初步数据与后续测试之间的逻辑反差。

back_content.text: 结论：初步数据虽有望，but 严格测试证实结果源于校准误差，而非真实效果。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：While the preliminary data looked promising, subsequent rigorous testing demonstrated that the initial results were, in fact, attributable to a calibration error rather than a genuine effect.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：While（让步连词）引导初步数据，主句通过 demonstrated + attributable to error 否定其有效性。② 核心规律：While（让步）+ 主句（真实结论）= CET6 学术转折最典型结构。③ 验证与迁移："in fact" = 事实上（强调真相），"rather than" = 而非（排除假原因）；两者共同指向标准答案。
tips: While...but/yet 双转折结构 = 答案在主句，前置 while 从句是被否定的假设。
attributable to = 归因于，是解释变量归属的高频学术表达。
